Question: Where was the 14th Asia Security Summit (Shangri-La Dialogue) held in May 2015? [2015 CDS-II]
Explanation: Solution: The 14th Asia Security Summit (Shangri-La Dialogue) was held in Singapore in May 2015. The forum gets its name from the Shangri-La Hotel in Singapore where it has been held since 2002. © examsnet.com
